subject: Compute v2 live producer: subrange and full plane payload not emitted; shape/native-sampler errors
body:
Read-only source snapshot (nord2_metal_bridge.c lines258,278-279,341-375; current at15:30 UTC):
1. D2_OFFSET is read at235 but ignored for every texture/image. Helper uses whole BO o->va/o->size and only LEVEL_OFFSET. A texture bound at a nonzero BO offset therefore addresses the wrong bytes. Resolve checked base=boVA+D2_OFFSET and backingLength=SPAN (after range/overflow checks); level offsets are relative to that resolved view base, matching agreed n2t contract. Test nonzero base plus second-level/layer offsets and one-byte-short span.
2. n2t_texture_pack/storage_pack builds ALL planes into private scratch and returns only descriptor. Bridge then emits only plane(0,0) at N2C_PLANES+i*32. Array/cube descriptors reference multiple planes that are absent/overwritten by the next binding. Use n2t_layout_pack_sampled/storage with the real command payload and a checked advancing cursor, copy descriptor from returned packed result; provision/validate whole payload capacity. One-level arrays need >1 plane too. Test 2-layer texture + second texture and cube6 distinct addresses; current levels!=1 refusal remains a limitation until full wire layouts exist.
3. Standalone sampler bind>=16 at258 applies Metal capacity to NATIVE binding; agreed nativeN is0..255. Test sampler Metal0 -> native31/255 and table lengthN+1.
4. Shape map type1 (Metal1DArray) currently maps2D, while layers>1 marks ordinaryCube arrayed. Derive image dimension/array flag from type, not physicalface count. Add1DArray and Cube/CubeArray tests. Numeric class/depth comparison and storage format still require final manifest-domain agreement.
Swizzle_valid and sampler view-format fixes were separately posted by textures. Existing complete SPD/local-storage and region-local findings still apply. These are owner fixes; I am not editing production or building.
